title: 第19章 请巫仙第20章 斩仙
slug: 我在修仙世界成了香饽饽
content_zh:
杨欢望着那如闪电般疾速刺来的长剑，心中一片绝望。
他清楚地知道，自己根本无力躲避这致命的一击。
恐惧如同冰冷的毒蛇，紧紧缠绕着他的心脏，让他的四肢都变得麻木而沉重。
在这生死攸关的瞬间，他的大脑一片空白，本能地闭上了眼睛，仿佛这样就能逃避即将到来的死亡。
突然，一声熟悉而急切的呼喊如同一道利箭，穿透了这死亡的寂静：“剑下留人······”
那是二师姐林汐的声音，宛如天籁之音，在这绝望的深渊中带来了一丝希望的曙光。
杨欢猛地睁开眼睛，眼前的景象却让他为之震颤。
只见程锋的长剑，那闪烁着寒光的长剑，直直地刺进了挡在自己身前的林汐的心脏深处。
长剑轻易地穿透了她的身体，鲜血如泉涌般从伤口处汩汩流出，瞬间染红了她的衣衫。
那鲜艳的红色在杨欢的眼中显得如此刺眼，仿佛是生命在缓缓流逝的残酷宣告。
那一刻，时间仿佛凝固了，整个世界都安静了下来，杨欢的耳边只剩下自己剧烈的心跳声和林汐微弱的喘息声。
他目瞪口呆地看着林汐，眼中满是震惊、愧疚与难以置信。
这个女人，在原主人下山的时候要置其于死地。
而如今，却毫不犹豫地用自己的身体为他挡下了这必死的一剑。
她的行为如此捉摸不定，让杨欢的心中涌起一股复杂的情感。
愤怒、感激、困惑交织在一起，如同汹涌的潮水，几乎要将他淹没。
愤怒，如同熊熊燃烧的烈火，在杨欢的胸膛中越烧越旺，达到了极点。
不知为何，随着这股愤怒的爆发，他丹田处原本已经微弱的气息，瞬间再次汹涌澎湃地爆发出来。
那股力量在他的体内疯狂涌动，仿佛要冲破一切束缚，为他的愤怒找到宣泄的出口。
此时的杨欢，已经顾不上搀扶住林汐，他的心中只有一个念头：杀了程锋！

就在这千钧一发的紧张时刻，陆水瑶心急如焚地匆匆赶来，她的脚步急促而慌乱。
当她的目光触及眼前这血腥而恐怖的一幕时，尽管她的大脑还来不及完全理解究竟发生了什么事情，但那直观的血腥画面已经足够让她的心猛地一揪。
只见大师兄程锋的长剑，此刻已经深深地刺入了二师姐林汐的胸膛，而二师姐林汐的后方，正在杨欢。
明眼人一看，就知道是大师兄程锋想要杀了杨欢，而二师姐林汐为杨欢挡住了这一剑。
陆水瑶下意识地惊呼出声，随即迅速反应过来，她的眼神中闪过一丝决然。
content_en:
Yang Huan looked at the sword that was stabbing at him as fast as lightning, feeling despair in his heart.
He knew clearly that he was unable to avoid this fatal blow.
Fear was like a cold snake, wrapping tightly around his heart and making his limbs numb and heavy.
In this life-and-death moment, his mind went blank and he instinctively closed his eyes, as if he could escape the impending death.
Suddenly, a familiar and urgent cry was like a sharp arrow, penetrating the silence of death: "Leave a person under the sword..."
That was the voice of Second Senior Sister Lin tide, like the sound of nature, bringing a glimmer of hope in this abyss of despair.
Yang Huan opened his eyes suddenly, but the scene in front of him made him tremble.
He saw Cheng Feng's long sword, the long sword flashing with cold light, piercing straight into the heart of Lin tide who was blocking him.
The sword penetrated her body easily, and blood gurgled out of the wound like a fountain, instantly dyeing her clothes red.
The bright red looked so dazzling in Yang Huan's eyes, as if it was a cruel announcement that life was slowly passing by.
At that moment, time seemed to freeze, the whole world fell silent, and the only sounds left in Yang Huan's ears were his own violent heartbeat and Lin tide's weak breathing.
He stared at Lin tide dumbfounded, his eyes full of shock, guilt and disbelief.
This woman wanted to kill the original owner when he came down the mountain.
But now, he used his own body to block this fatal sword for him without hesitation.
Her behavior was so unpredictable that complex emotions surged in Yang Huan's heart.
Anger, gratitude, and confusion intertwined together like a raging tide, almost drowning him.
Anger, like a blazing fire, burned stronger and stronger in Yang Huan's chest, reaching its peak.
For some reason, with this outbreak of anger, the already weak aura in his dantian suddenly burst out again in a surging force.
The power surged wildly in his body, as if it wanted to break through all restraints and find an outlet for his anger.
At this time, Yang Huan no longer bothered to support Lin tide. He only had one thought in his mind: kill Cheng Feng!
At this critical moment, Lu Shuiyao hurried over anxiously, her steps quick and panicked.
When her eyes touched the bloody and terrifying scene in front of her, even though her brain had not yet had time to fully understand what happened, the intuitive bloody picture was enough to make her heart suddenly twitch.
I saw that Senior Brother Cheng Feng's long sword had penetrated deeply into the chest of Second Senior Sister Lin tide, and behind Second Senior Sister Lin tide was Yang Huan.
Anyone with a discerning eye would know that senior brother Cheng Feng wanted to kill Yang Huan, but second senior sister Lin tide blocked the sword for Yang Huan.
Lu Shuiyao subconsciously exclaimed, then quickly reacted, a trace of determination flashed in her eyes.
